floors.name: Ground floor
floors.source: Columns from the new 1st floor drawing (10 Oct 2026): the columns that stand on the ground floor and hold up the 1st floor. There is no new ground floor slab drawing, so no slab edge is drawn here.
notes: Grid 4 to 5 is written 3975 on the new plans, but it is drawn 4000 and the sections say 4000 (3 to 5 = 5650). The app uses 3975: measure it on site.

floors.name: 1st floor
floors.source: Slab from the new 1st floor drawing (10 Oct 2026). Columns from the new 2nd floor drawing (12 Oct 2026): the columns that stand on this floor and hold up the 2nd floor.
notes: Grid 4 to 5 is written 3975 on the new plans, but it is drawn 4000 and the sections say 4000 (3 to 5 = 5650). The app uses 3975: measure it on site.
The balconies between K–L and M–N are written 1850 from grid 7 but drawn 1925. The app uses 1850: measure them.

floors.name: 2nd floor
floors.source: Slab from the new 2nd floor drawing (12 Oct 2026). Columns copied from it too: the new 3rd floor drawing hasn't come yet, and the old drawings used the same columns for these two floors.
notes: Grid 4 to 5 is written 3975 on the new plans, but it is drawn 4000 and the sections say 4000 (3 to 5 = 5650). The app uses 3975: measure it on site.
The B–C block's left edge is written 500 from grid B but drawn 575 (575 on the 1st floor). The app uses 500.
The B–C block's right edge is written 1550 from grid C but drawn 1575 (1575 on the 1st floor). The app uses 1550.
